name: diagram-architect
description: Turns a vague drawing request into a deliverable figure: decides whether a figure is worth drawing, picks the diagram type and the output channel (inline widget vs. saved artifact), routes across five diagramming libraries, and passes a mechanical quality gate before delivery.

displayDescription.en: Turns a vague drawing request into a deliverable figure: picks the diagram type and the output channel, routes across five diagramming libraries, and passes a mechanical quality gate before handing anything over.
displayDescription.zh: 把模糊的绘图需求变成可交付的图表：定图型、定出口，调度五套绘图能力库，过机械质检再交付。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 把这个系统的架构画成一张图，标出主要请求路径
